`paqtra-mcp` 2.2.3 registers **39 tools**, every one of them a read (`readOnlyHint`) over the Paqtra REST API. There is no write tool. See [MCP integration](../integrations/mcp-integration.md) for setup.

## Flows

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `paqtra_flow` | Get one flow by id. |
| `paqtra_flow_history` | Query stored flow history. |
| `paqtra_flow_stats` | Flow totals: forwarded, dropped, requests per second, average latency. |
| `paqtra_flow_store` | Size, retention and health of the flow history store. |
| `paqtra_flow_timeline` | Flow counts over time from stored history. |
| `paqtra_flows` | List recent Hubble flows, optionally filtered by namespace or verdict (FORWARDED, DROPPED). |

## Policies and Cilium

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `paqtra_cilium_agent` | Read-only Cilium agent query (status, endpoints, identities, ...). |
| `paqtra_cilium_features` | Enabled Cilium features (kube-proxy replacement, encryption, Hubble, ...). |
| `paqtra_cilium_metrics` | Cilium agent metrics summary. |
| `paqtra_cilium_resources` | List Cilium custom resources of a kind (for example ciliumnetworkpolicies, ciliumendpoints). |
| `paqtra_hubble_metrics` | Hubble metrics summary. |
| `paqtra_hubble_nodes` | Hubble relay node status. |
| `paqtra_policies` | List network policies (Cilium CNP/CCNP) Paqtra can see. |
| `paqtra_policy` | Get one network policy by id. |

## Investigate

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `paqtra_connectivity_alerts` | Connectivity alerts raised by declared paths. |
| `paqtra_connectivity_path_status` | Current status of one declared connectivity path. |
| `paqtra_connectivity_paths` | Declared connectivity paths being watched. |
| `paqtra_healer_problems` | Problems the healer module has detected (listing only; fixes are not exposed). |
| `paqtra_investigate_flow` | Explain one flow: which policy or condition allowed or dropped it. |
| `paqtra_investigate_path` | Answer why workload A cannot reach B: evidence from flows, drops and policy. |
| `paqtra_investigation` | Fetch a stored investigation bundle by id. |
| `paqtra_rootcause_drops` | Recent packet drops with reasons. |

## Anomalies

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `paqtra_anomalies` | Detected network anomalies. |
| `paqtra_anomaly` | Get one anomaly by id. |

## Security and compliance

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `paqtra_compliance_audit` | Get one compliance audit by id. |
| `paqtra_compliance_audits` | Past compliance audits. |
| `paqtra_compliance_frameworks` | Supported compliance frameworks. |
| `paqtra_security_findings` | Security findings from the dashboard. |
| `paqtra_security_posture` | Overall security posture summary. |
| `paqtra_zero_trust` | Zero-trust score per namespace. |

## eBPF

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `paqtra_ebpf_attachments` | BPF program attachments classified as cil_*, netra_* or other (read-only). |
| `paqtra_ebpf_drift` | BPF attachment drift against the last known state. |
| `paqtra_ebpf_programs` | Loaded eBPF programs and their runtime stats. |

## Cluster

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `paqtra_dependencies` | Observed service dependency graph. |
| `paqtra_endpoints` | Cilium endpoints. |
| `paqtra_events` | Recent Kubernetes and Cilium events. |
| `paqtra_health` | API health. |
| `paqtra_heatmap` | Traffic heatmap data. |
| `paqtra_nodes` | Cluster nodes and their Cilium agent state. |
